description_en: Queries the information about a job in an E-HPC cluster

kebab_example: aliyun ehpc describe-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --job-id 1.scheduler0000 --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeJob
